bio: If you have yet to discover the modern cuisine of Trás-os-Montes, the “wonderful kingdom” extolled by the renowned writer Miguel Torga, you cannot miss this restaurant, an example of honesty, passion and a desire to excel. Expertly run by the Geadas brothers, with the media-savvy Óscar in the kitchen while António supervises the dining room and acts as sommelier, it boasts a classic décor and a spectacular view over the city’s fortress. Chestnuts, mushrooms, aromatic herbs, variants of the typical alheira sausage, a cheese trolley... local products take the lead in various menus: a seasonal one, a vegetarian one, and five more dedicated to renowned artists from the Porto School of Fine Arts (Amândio Silva, Júlio Resende, Graça Morais, Armando Alves and Nadir Afonso). A characteristic dish?...
